measurementScope: Actual macOS Tauri WKWebView run using a local SQLite fixture. Twelve 50,000-row, four-column reads traversed the production Operation, read-only pool, bounded Tauri Channel, React commit acknowledgement, audit, and history path. Aggregate durations only; no SQL text, row values, connection identifiers, or credentials.

decisions.sqliteProvenance: Keep the serialized tamper-evident audit append and scope-pinned history insert. Their combined post-finalize p95 is below 1 ms and they run after the first interactive commit, so combining or weakening those safety boundaries has no measured UX benefit.
decisions.poolInitialization: Keep access-keyed lazy write-pool creation. Read acquisitions open only a DB-enforced read-only pool; a separate writable pool is created only after an approved write acquisition. The measured warm read-pool handoff p95 is 160 us, so parallel eager initialization would add unused authority and connections.
decisions.nextBottleneck: The full 50,000-row completion is dominated by 196 bounded WebView acknowledgement cycles, while click-to-interactive p95 is 6 ms. Preserve the current 256-row memory bound unless full-result completion becomes a user-visible bottleneck.
